//ConnectionStrings: Needed for migrations and anything hitting the database. The debate endpoints do not touch it. LocalDB below is the zero-setup Windows default; swap in the team's server as needed.
//Authentication: Dev-only signing key so a locally-issued machine token can be verified. Never reuse this value anywhere real.
//BundleStorage: Local scratch directory for uploaded bundles.

Models.//Provider: Overrides the committed default of Scripted. Requires the keys below.
Models.//HighTierModel: Shared tier defaults. A per-agent Model below overrides these.
Models.//ApiKey: Optional shared fallback for any agent whose own key is blank.
Models.//Agents: One key per agent, so rate limits and spend are isolated per role.
//Pricing: SEC-31 - money per MILLION tokens, per tier. Built-in list prices cover Azure,
Anthropic and Scripted; NIM ships none, so set these to price a NIM run rather
than have its tokens reported as unpriced.
//AzureOpenAI: To run on Azure instead, set Provider to AzureOpenAI and add Endpoint below.
Endpoint has no default - the host contains your own resource name.
Under Azure, HighTierModel/CheapTierModel are DEPLOYMENT names, not model names:
Azure has no way to request 'gpt-4o' by name, only the deployment you created.

//Tiers: SEC-31 routing. Shipped policy: the three reasoning turns on High, the
Orchestrator's briefing on Cheap. Override per role only if you mean it -
moving the Reporter to Cheap degrades adjudication to save fractions of a cent.
